purpose: Map AGENTS.md status vocabulary to the AAA evidence ladder so future agents cannot promote curation, runtime, budget or release claims through ambiguous wording.
global_rules: Use AGENTS.md vocabulary exactly when reporting project/runtime status.
Use curation package status only for the curation package itself.
Never use pronto, AAA, validado, entregue or final as synonyms for missing evidence.
The allowed status is the lowest proven status across all affected domains.

allowed_when: There is a curation record, note, plan, schema, prompt or documentation artifact.
forbidden_when: The answer implies implementation, build, runtime or quality proof.

allowed_when: A schema-backed contract, owner skill and blocker/evidence path exist.
forbidden_when: No implementation file, runtime asset or validator output exists.

allowed_when: The relevant file, skill, asset, script or resource exists in the workspace.
forbidden_when: No build or validator output exists.

allowed_when: A build command executed and produced the declared ROM/output.
forbidden_when: Build is assumed, old, or not tied to the current worktree.

allowed_when: The required emulator evidence exists, with BlastEm used when required by the project.
forbidden_when: Only build output, editor screenshot, expected behavior or text report exists.

allowed_when: VRAM, CRAM, SAT, DMA, scanline, VDP dump or equivalent budget evidence exists for the claim.
forbidden_when: Only screenshot, build output or visual plausibility exists.

allowed_when: Curation artifacts were written but local validation, audits, commit or push are not proven.
forbidden_when: Validator and workspace audits have passed and package status files were promoted.

allowed_when: The curation validator passes, workspace audits are handled, and status files are updated from recovery plan.
forbidden_when: Runner execution is blocked or command output is missing.

allowed_when: All activated domain gates pass, visual/human review requirements are met, and emulator/VDP evidence exists for runtime claims.
forbidden_when: This is only a curation package validation, build success, report, screenshot-only proof or partial asset.

forbidden_synonym_rules.required_replacement: Use the exact proven status: documentado, implementado, buildado, testado_em_emulador, validado_budget, candidate_aaa or validated_curation.
Specify whether validation means package validator, emulator evidence, VDP budget evidence or human visual review.
Use candidate_aaa or ready_for_aaa only if the evidence ladder and guardian allow it.
